+from pyasn1.type import char
+
+# Create a string with distinct bytes that would be obvious if reversed
+test_str = 'ABC'
+utf8 = char.UTF8String(test_str)
+result = utf8.asOctets()
+expected = test_str.encode('utf-8')
+
+print("Test string:", test_str)
+print("Result:", repr(result))
+print("Expected:", repr(expected))
+print("Are they equal?", result == expected)
+
+if result != expected:
+    print("Bytes are reversed!")
+    print("Result reversed:", repr(result[::-1]))
+    print("Match with reversed?", result[::-1] == expected)
+else:
+    print("Bytes are correct.")
